item.title: Patch now: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router: OS Command Injection
item.description:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router: RCE · pre-auth · internet-facing · exploited · fix: 7.0.5, 7.1.7, 7.2.3

First step: Update Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router to the fixed version for your release line (for example 7.0.5, 7.1.7 or 7.2.3).

Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

Critical · Fix available · CVE-2026-103406
